entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
14.11.2023 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)
01.
1.

This is an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Balangir Sadar P.S. Case No.217 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.819 of 2023, pending in the file of the learned S.D.J.M., Balangir under Section 394 of IPC.
2.

The petitioners had moved an application for bail before the Court of the learned Sessions Judge,
Balangir, which was rejected on 18.10.2023.

entities.text:
Court of the learned Sessions Judge,
Balangir
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The prosecution allegation in brief is that on 13.06.2023 at about 3.00 p.m., the petitioners came to the shop of the informant and forcibly took away a sum of Rs.500/- from his drawer by showing a knife.
Both the accused assaulted the informant and threatened him with dire consequences.

4. Mr.P.K.Negi, learned counsel for the petitioners appearing from the Virtual High Court at Balangir submits that the petitioners are in custody since 05.06.2023, investigation has been completed in the meanwhile, no injury has been detected on the informant and the amount has been recovered.
He further submits that the petitioners are willing to abide by any stringent condition which may be imposed by this Court.

He also submits that the antecedents which are alleged against petitioner No.1-Ashok Harpal are of the year 2016-2021 and the antecedent of petitioner No.2-Gobinda Barik is under Section 376 D and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 5. Mr. A.P.Das, learned Addl.
Standing Counsel opposes the prayer for bail stating that the petitioner No.1 is a history sheeter and they may commit similar offence while on bail.

6. Considering the nature of allegations and the submission that the cases pending against petitioner No.1-Ashok Harpal are of the year 2016-2021 and the antecedent of petitioner No.2 is not similar in nature, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

7. Let the petitioners - Ashok Harpal and Gobinda Barik be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be fixed by the learned Court below in seisin over the matter, including the following conditions:
(i) They will not indulge in any criminal activity while on bail.
(ii) They will not threaten or try to influence prosecution witnesses while on bail.
(iii) After their release, they will co-operate with the investigation and will appear before the IIC, Balangir Sadar P.S. on every Monday and Thursday between 4.00 p.m. to 6.00 p.m. till completion of trial.
8. Violation of any condition will entail in cancellation of bail.
9. The BLAPL is accordingly allowed.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
11. A copy of this order be supplied to Mr.A.P.Das, learned Addl.

Standing Counsel for onward transmission to the I.O.
..............................
